# hiloop skills

> Open-source Agent Skills that teach AI agents to operate hiloop — isolated agent sandboxes you can
> snapshot and branch, with run-scoped observability. The skills drive hiloop through the `hiloop`
> CLI and follow the open Agent Skills standard, so they work across harnesses.
>
> Status: core sandbox lifecycle and buffered exec are served. Optional capabilities are
> deployment-dependent and refuse explicitly when absent; `operating-sandboxes` carries the
> current capability table. Every create returns an ambient run with managed explicit-entrypoint,
> exec, SSH-output, cooperative HTTP, and OTLP capture.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): whole-product orientation — the interface, the always-in-order rules, the canonical end-to-end loop.

## Skills

- [autoresearch](skills/autoresearch/SKILL.md): run a complete local metric-driven research loop — propose diverse ideas, execute bounded arms, record evolving idea cards and immutable scored experiments, ensemble winners, and expose a leaderboard.
- [authenticating](skills/authenticating/SKILL.md): point the CLI at a deployment (the built-in default edge is not live), sign in with hiloop login (default) or HILOOP_API_KEY (headless/CI), whoami, key management; organization scope is implied by the credential.
- [operating-sandboxes](skills/operating-sandboxes/SKILL.md): create/list/get/exec/stop/start/delete, the ambient-run receipt and managed capture boundaries, the deployment capability table, and conditional references for managed SSH/file transfer, snapshots/branching, and persistent dev environments.
- [managing-volumes](skills/managing-volumes/SKILL.md): `hiloop volume create` (--size-gb quota) / push (content-addressed, deduplicated, never half-published) / list / get / delete, and mounting with `sandbox create --volume <name>:/abs/path` — name resolved client-side, version pinned at admission.
- [managing-secrets](skills/managing-secrets/SKILL.md): write-only hiloop secret set/list/rotate/revoke via piped stdin; local runs cannot bind stored values, and sandbox bindings fail closed until proof-bound request-time delivery ships.
- [launching-as-workloads](skills/launching-as-workloads/SKILL.md): hiloop workloads create/list/show/delete/allow-launch + `--as workload/<name>` on hiloop run (currently the only verb that takes it) — named machine identities with kinded launch ACLs (restrict to users by id and/or service-account keys via allow-launch --user/--service-account); registration is explicit, launching as an unregistered name fails closed (not_found), and delete is owner/admin-only with a confirmation prompt (`--yes` to skip; live sandboxes conflict, past attribution keeps only the raw id).
- [querying-observability](skills/querying-observability/SKILL.md): capture locally with hiloop run or use a sandbox's managed ambient capture, orient with runs list/show/tail/complete, query with read-only SQL over events and views, scope by run identity, tail, and fetch payloads.
- [annotating-runs](skills/annotating-runs/SKILL.md): hiloop annotation-schema + hiloop annotations add (a run, an event, a time range, or a project); structured judgments you can filter and aggregate on via ann_<schema> views.
- [reporting-product-bugs](skills/reporting-product-bugs/SKILL.md): hiloop feedback (or POST /v1/feedback) — report a hiloop product bug with expected/actual/repro, evidence ids, severity, fingerprint dedup; product bugs and ideas, never task results.

## Reference

- [fleet dashboard](tools/fleet-dashboard/README.md): public Rich terminal dashboard for runs, lineage, experiment leaderboard, and recent events.
- [events SQL reference](skills/querying-observability/references/events-sql.md): the read-only SQL query surface — the events table columns, query rules, example SELECTs.
- [sandbox session reference](skills/operating-sandboxes/references/sessions.md): managed SSH, port forwarding, and file transfer.
- [sandbox snapshot reference](skills/operating-sandboxes/references/snapshots.md): snapshot durability and branching with `create --from`.
- [persistent sandbox reference](skills/operating-sandboxes/references/devbox.md): compose a long-lived development environment from ordinary sandbox verbs.
